stories.headline: Pearsall's Knee Gives Out for Good and Deebo Rides Back Into Town
stories.read: John Lynch made it official: Ricky Pearsall is headed for season-ending surgery on that busted PCL, and the fella won't take a snap in 2026. San Francisco turned right around and re-signed Deebo Samuel to plug the hole. Here's Doc's read, pardner: a whole mess of throws just came loose in that Shanahan wagon and somebody's gotta catch 'em. Jauan Jennings and a healthy George Kittle are the safest bets to collect, and Deebo's price in the saloon is still cheap on account of last year's cold streak. Pearsall's a dry well now. Cross him off and go stake the fellas standing next to the spill.

stories.headline: Gibbs Watches Practice With His Arms Folded and His Contract Unsigned
stories.read: Detroit's best horse turned up at Sunday's practice for the first time all summer, stood on the sideline, said nothin' to anybody, and walked off. Campbell calls the back tightness minor; Rapoport says the real holdup is a payday that could make Gibbs the richest ball-carrier in the whole territory, north of twenty million. Doc ain't spooked, and neither should you be. This is a fella holdin' out for money, not a fella who can't run. The nervous folks in your outfit will slide him down a peg for missin' camp reps, which means you might get a top-three ball-carrier at fourth-round prices. If he's still on the board when the herd gets jumpy, you take him. And keep David Montgomery saddled just in case the standoff runs long.

stories.headline: Worthy Tweaks the Shoulder Again and the Whole Saloon Flinches
stories.read: The speedster limped off Kansas City's practice field holdin' that shoulder, the same one he had cut open this offseason. Andy Reid put the fire out quick: a sprain, maybe a few days, nothin' long-term. Now listen close, because this is where the money is. Worthy already told everybody he was never right last year, which explains that whole ugly stretch of 42 catches and one trip to paydirt. Fixed shoulder, full offseason, and a market that's been sellin' him at a discount ever since. One bad practice ain't a reason to run. It's a reason to buy. Let the spooked fellas pass on him and you go strike that vein.
